description.value: Big Horn Cafe is a specialty espresso-and-scratch-baking cafe that opened in 2017 in the mountain town of Radium Hot Springs, equipped with Italian La Marzocco espresso machines and a broad menu of house-baked goods, soups, sandwiches, and seasonal pies. Situated close to Kootenay National Park, it draws adventure travellers with vegan, gluten-free, and non-dairy options, a dog-friendly outdoor patio, free Wi-Fi, and a boutique stocked with locally crafted Columbia Valley food products. The owner-operated cafe positions itself as both a community gathering spot and a provisioning stop for visitors heading into the surrounding mountains.

address.value: 7527 Main Street W, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

No bike-specific amenities — racks, pump, e-bike charging, or bike parking — are mentioned anywhere on the site; the contact page provides the full address (7527 Main Street W, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0) and phone (403-861-2978), with the Alberta area code being plausible given Radium Hot Springs' position on the BC-AB border.
